query:
SELECT COALESCE(gf.state <> 0, TRUE) AS "allowed!"
        FROM rb_ticket tk
        JOIN rb_team t ON t.id = tk.team_id
        LEFT JOIN rb_game_feature gf ON gf.game_id = t.game_id
            AND gf.feature_type = CASE WHEN tk.puzzle_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
        WHERE tk.id = $1;
